---
title: "A Little About Me"
---

I'm a data scientist at [Ketchbrook Analytics](https://www.ketchbrookanalytics.com/). I live in [Fargo, North Dakota](https://www.fargomoorhead.org/) with my wife, Lindsey, and our goldendoodle, Ellie. I enjoy coffee, taking our dog for walks, working out, and listening to podcasts.

I attended the [University of North Dakota](https://und.edu/about/index.html) and obtained a [Bachelors of Accountancy](https://und.edu/programs/accountancy-bacc/requirements.html) and a [Bachelors of Business Adminstration](https://und.edu/programs/business-economics-bba/requirements.html), specializing in Economics.

I began my professional life in finance before finding a career in data. These days, I primarily work with open-source technologies including [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) and [Python](https://www.python.org/).
